tool_schemas.name: wait
tool_schemas.description: Pauses execution for the requested duration (0–300 seconds) and returns a wait record representing this invocation for auditing and observability. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `seconds` is missing, not a number, or outside the allowed range, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to invoke waits. Raises RATE_LIMITED if the caller exceeds configured wait/usage limits or QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account has no remaining wait capacity.

seconds.description: The number of seconds to wait (0-300)

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key for authenticating Wait API calls. Returns the created api_keys record and the plaintext API key exactly once; later reads never return the plaintext key. Refuses if the caller is not authorized to create keys or if requested limits exceed service bounds.

name.description: A human-friendly name for the API key.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum number of wait requests allowed per minute for this key.

max_seconds_per_request.description: Maximum seconds allowed per wait request for this key (must be <= 300).

tool_schemas.name: list_wait_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists wait requests for the authenticated API key with optional filtering and pagination, newest first by requested_at. Returns only records visible to the caller. Refuses if the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

requested_after.description: Only include requests requested at or after this timestamp (RFC3339).

requested_before.description: Only include requests requested at or before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_wait_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single wait request by id. Returns the wait_requests record if it belongs to the authenticated API key. Refuses if the API key is missing/invalid or the record is not found/accessible.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_wait_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running wait request. Transitions status to cancelled and sets completed_at. Refuses if the request is already completed/cancelled/failed, if the transition is not permitted, or if the request is not owned by the authenticated API key.

id.description: The wait request id to cancel.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason for auditing (may be recorded in logs/observability).

tool_schemas.name: get_usage
tool_schemas.description: Returns current identity and entitlement information for the calling API key, including its status, configured limits, and current minute window usage for rate limiting. Refuses if the API key is missing/invalid.

window_start.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp; usage is computed for date_trunc('minute', window_start). Defaults to now().

tool_schemas.name: revoke_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Revokes an API key, transitioning it from active to revoked and setting revoked_at. Refuses if the key is already revoked or if the caller is not authorized to revoke it.
